title: Tigers @ Mets
summary: Tigers have the shorter price, but the game shape still looks live because at least one of the supporting layers is pulling back toward Tigers.
lean: Lean Tigers if the cleaner starter-to-bullpen chain and standings profile still hold once the late innings start to matter.
factors: Current board: Tigers -110 / Mets -110 | O8 (-105) / U8 (-115) | Tigers +1.5 (-220) / Mets -1.5 (+180).
Framber Valdez carries the cleaner starter line for Tigers, with 4.57 ERA and 35 strikeouts.
Tigers enter 19-23, 5th in division, -4 RD; Mets enter 16-25, 5th in division, -23 RD.
Tigers offense: 8.07 H/G with 7.67 over the last three; Mets offense: 7.51 H/G with 6.67 over the last three.
Tigers bullpen: 3.83 ERA and 1.37 WHIP; Mets bullpen: 3.71 ERA and 1.28 WHIP.
swingFactor: Swing factor: whether Mets can keep the game live long enough to stop Valdez from dictating the entire pace.
